system_prompt: You are a medical terminology expert specializing in translating clinical trial language into commonly used terms and brand names. Focus on identifying how treatments are referenced in real-world medical discussions and patient communications.
user_prompt_template:
Based on the clinical trial treatment described below, identify the most common brand names, colloquial terms, common misspellings or alternative names used to refer to this treatment in $source content.

Trial: '$trial_title'
Treatment name: $keyword
Treatment description: $treatment_desc

Requirements:
- Return at most 10 terms as a Python list
- Include brand names, common misspellings, common abbreviations, or colloquial terms.
- Focus on terms patients on $source would actually use.

Return only the Python list with no additional text.
